metadata.schema: Smart City (9 tables: districts, zones, camera_locations, roads, traffic_readings, violations, weather_data, incidents, infrastructure_projects)
metadata.notes: Expected SQL uses column names from the actual Smart City database schema.

questions.question: List all districts
questions.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM districts

questions.question: Show all camera locations
questions.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM camera_locations

questions.question: How many zones are there?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zones

questions.question: List all violation types
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT violation_type FROM violations

questions.question: Show only approved infrastructure projects
questions.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM infrastructure_projects WHERE status = 'Approved'

questions.question: Which cameras are of type speed?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM camera_locations WHERE camera_type = 'speed'

questions.question: Show incidents that are still ongoing
questions.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM incidents WHERE status = 'Ongoing'

questions.question: List roads with more than 3 lanes
questions.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM roads WHERE lanes > 3

questions.question: How many traffic violations happened in each district?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(*) as total FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id JOIN districts d ON r.district_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id

questions.question: What is the average vehicle count per zone?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT z.name, AVG(tr.vehicle_count) FROM traffic_readings tr JOIN camera_locations cl ON tr.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id JOIN zones z ON r.zone_id = z.id GROUP BY z.id

questions.question: What is the total budget of all infrastructure projects?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(budget) FROM infrastructure_projects

questions.question: How many incidents were reported per severity level?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT severity, COUNT(*) FROM incidents GROUP BY severity

questions.question: Show cameras and which road they are on
questions.expected_sql: SELECT cl.location_desc, r.road_name FROM camera_locations cl JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id

questions.question: List districts and how many roads each has
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(r.id) FROM districts d JOIN roads r ON d.id = r.district_id GROUP BY d.id

questions.question: Show air quality readings with zone names
questions.expected_sql: SELECT z.name, w.pm25, w.pm10, w.recorded_at FROM weather_data w JOIN zones z ON w.zone_id = z.id WHERE w.data_type = 'air_quality'

questions.question: Which district has the most camera locations?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(cl.id) as camera_count FROM districts d JOIN roads r ON d.id = r.district_id JOIN camera_locations cl ON r.id = cl.road_id GROUP BY d.id ORDER BY camera_count DESC LIMIT 1
questions.description: Multi-JOIN with ORDER BY and LIMIT

questions.question: Which camera detects the most violations?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT cl.location_desc, cl.camera_type, COUNT(*) as total_violations FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id GROUP BY cl.id ORDER BY total_violations DESC LIMIT 1
questions.description: JOIN with GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT

questions.question: Show the average speed per road during peak hours
questions.expected_sql: SELECT r.road_name, AVG(tr.avg_speed) FROM traffic_readings tr JOIN camera_locations cl ON tr.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id WHERE tr.is_peak_hour = 1 GROUP BY r.id
questions.description: Multi-JOIN with boolean filter and AVG

questions.question: What is the total fine amount per violation type?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT violation_type, SUM(fine_amount) as total_fines FROM violations GROUP BY violation_type ORDER BY total_fines DESC
questions.description: GROUP BY with SUM and ORDER BY

questions.question: Which districts have infrastructure projects with budget over 500000?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, ip.project_name, ip.budget FROM infrastructure_projects ip JOIN districts d ON ip.district_id = d.id WHERE ip.budget > 500000

questions.question: Which zone has the worst air quality (highest PM2.5)?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT z.name, MAX(w.pm25) as max_pm25 FROM weather_data w JOIN zones z ON w.zone_id = z.id WHERE w.data_type = 'air_quality' GROUP BY z.id ORDER BY max_pm25 DESC LIMIT 1
questions.description: MAX with JOIN, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT

questions.question: Show districts with both incidents and violations
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.name FROM districts d WHERE d.id IN (SELECT r.district_id FROM roads r JOIN camera_locations cl ON r.id = cl.road_id JOIN violations v ON cl.id = v.camera_id) AND d.id IN (SELECT district_id FROM incidents)

questions.question: What is the average response time for incidents per district?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, AVG(i.response_time_minutes) FROM incidents i JOIN districts d ON i.district_id = d.id WHERE i.response_time_minutes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.id

questions.question: List roads with above-average congestion level
questions.expected_sql: SELECT r.road_name, AVG(tr.congestion_level) as avg_congestion FROM traffic_readings tr JOIN camera_locations cl ON tr.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id HAVING AVG(tr.congestion_level) > (SELECT AVG(congestion_level) FROM traffic_readings)

questions.question: Rank zones by their average air quality index
questions.expected_sql: SELECT z.name, AVG(w.air_quality_index) as avg_aqi, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(w.air_quality_index) DESC) as rank FROM weather_data w JOIN zones z ON w.zone_id = z.id WHERE w.air_quality_index IS NOT NULL GROUP BY z.id

questions.question: Show the running total of violations per day
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DATE(violation_time) as day, COUNT(*) as daily_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE(violation_time)) as running_total FROM violations GROUP BY DATE(violation_time)

questions.question: Find the busiest camera in each district
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, cl.location_desc, COUNT(v.id) as violation_count FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id JOIN districts d ON r.district_id = d.id GROUP BY cl.id ORDER BY d.name, violation_count DESC
questions.description: Multi-JOIN with GROUP BY and ORDER BY

questions.question: Compare total violations this month vs last month per district
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, SUM(CASE WHEN v.violation_time >= date('now', 'start of month') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as this_month, SUM(CASE WHEN v.violation_time < date('now', 'start of month') AND v.violation_time >= date('now', 'start of month', '-1 month') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as last_month FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id JOIN districts d ON r.district_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id

questions.question: Use a CTE to show district summaries with total violations, incidents, and projects
questions.expected_sql: WITH v AS (SELECT d.id, COUNT(*) as total_violations FROM violations v JOIN camera_locations cl ON v.camera_id = cl.id JOIN roads r ON cl.road_id = r.id JOIN districts d ON r.district_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id), i AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) as total_incidents FROM incidents GROUP BY district_id), p AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) as total_projects FROM infrastructure_projects GROUP BY district_id) SELECT d.name, COALESCE(v.total_violations, 0), COALESCE(i.total_incidents, 0), COALESCE(p.total_projects, 0) FROM districts d LEFT JOIN v ON d.id = v.id LEFT JOIN i ON d.id = i.district_id LEFT JOIN p ON d.id = p.district_id

questions.question: Show weather data trends - compare air quality between zones using a subquery
questions.expected_sql: SELECT z.name, AVG(w.air_quality_index) as avg_aqi FROM weather_data w JOIN zones z ON w.zone_id = z.id WHERE w.air_quality_index IS NOT NULL GROUP BY z.id HAVING AVG(w.air_quality_index) > (SELECT AVG(air_quality_index) FROM weather_data WHERE air_quality_index IS NOT NULL)
